flip.verdict: NO — open-entry does not flip who wins on hit-rate. c2c winner=book (46.5% vs 43.8%); o2c winner=book (58.9% vs 53.6%). Book hit-rate does cross 50% (46.5% c2c → 58.9% o2c), but that is the afternoon-book leak, not a rescue of the 09:30 sleeve. Mean ranking does not flip (c2c hot4 wins, book -0.03% vs hot-4 +0.93%; o2c hot4 wins, book +0.51% vs hot-4 +1.74%).

book_1d.why: Printed books land at mixed clocks (4 preopen / 9 session / 4 after close). Most 1d BUY lists are afternoon or overnight prints, so the honest 1d hop is close→next close (or next 09:30 if you refuse a same-day last). Same-day open→close is not a fill the afternoon book had — it grades a move already on the sheet.

hot4.why: union_hot_n4_h1 is a 09:30 list: hold=1 signal-only grades open→same close; the cash book buys the open and sells the next open. close→next close bills it for an overnight gap it never paid and is the wrong scoreboard default.

recommend.do_not: Do not put both sleeves on one c2c board and call that a fair hot-4 vs book bake-off.
